title: Battle of Kraaipan
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Kraaipan", at revision 1370446169, opens: "The Battle of Kraaipan was the first engagement of the Second Anglo-Boer War, fought at Kraaipan, South Africa on 12 October 1899." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q845845, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1899 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
